notes: Fixed Risk & Advisory Register severity counts: normRisk() lowercases severity ("high"/"medium") but the As-Built count table compared against capitalized keys, so every risk was miscounted as 'Unknown' despite each row showing the correct badge -- now matches case-insensitively. Fixed the As-Built Risk Register and Security Posture panels rendering blank risk titles: normRisk() has no `title` field, only `description` -- both panels now show the real description text instead of empty brackets like '[medium]'. Investigated the blank Monthly Capacity 'Used (TB)' column down to the live Active IQ API: confirmed this account's systems query falls back to a reduced field set (full query errors with 'Float cannot represent non numeric value: null'), and even the separate cluster-level monthlyCapacity query returns usedKiB=null for every month while rawMarketingKiB is populated -- Active IQ genuinely does not return historical used-capacity for this account. Added a per-month cluster-level fallback in server.py for cases where it does exist, and the UI now states explicitly when the column is unavailable instead of rendering a wall of dashes. Added tooltips explaining Active IQ's proprietary Propensity score (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) is computed entirely inside Active IQ, not by this tool.
